question:
Find the shortest route from S to E in the fewest moves.
One move = one step up, down, left or right. Walls (#) block your path. Coordinates are 1-indexed (row 1 is top row, column 1 is leftmost column). Pass through checkpoint 1 before reaching E. One-way cells (arrows) can only be entered and exited in the direction of the arrow.
...E#..
...###.
..>##..
...#1.#
.#.#..#
......#
...S...
hints: The one-way arrows restrict passage, forcing you to move in their indicated direction. You must also visit checkpoint 1 in the correct order.
From start cell S at row 7, col 4, the optimal opening move is up toward row 6, col 4.
